text:
The assistant followed the length constraint (fewer than two paragraphs), but failed significantly on the "unique" and "creative language" requirements. The response relies almost entirely on clichés and overused tropes: "heart of gold," "eyes the color of the sea," "voice like a thunderclap," and "man of few words." There is no specific or vivid imagery that makes this character stand out from a generic archetype; it reads like a collection of idioms rather than a creative character description.

Rating: [[3]]
